architecture.mechanism: DC-DC converter topology optimization for reduced conduction and switching losses
architecture.intervention: Replace the failing alternator rectifier and voltage regulator assembly with a high-efficiency isolated DC-DC converter topology selected from the reviewed configurations to minimize power loss and ensure stable output current.
architecture.expected_effect: The charging system will maintain battery charge levels sufficient for engine starting without jump starts by eliminating excessive conduction and switching losses that contribute to charging failure.
architecture.falsification_test: Measure the alternator output voltage and current ripple under a 50A load at idle; if voltage drops below 13.5V or ripple exceeds 500mV after the converter replacement, the mechanism has failed to address the loss parameters.
